outline.rationale: The user is a complete neural-net beginner aiming for theoretical/paper-reading fluency, so the outline builds from absolute foundations (neuron, learning) and the recurring math notation before introducing Transformer-specific ideas. A brief RNN node establishes the problem attention solves, motivating the architecture rather than presenting it cold. Embeddings, self-attention, and the multi-head/feed-forward machinery are split into separate nodes because each carries distinct math with low overlap. The architecture-assembly node integrates pieces, and the final node explicitly bridges to reading the original paper — directly serving the stated goal. Coding, frameworks, fine-tuning, and deployment are excluded per the confirmed understanding, keeping focus on conceptual and mathematical comprehension. Order is largely linear because real prerequisite dependencies exist (math before attention math, components before full architecture before paper).
